limitations: Fresh language score18/20below95%target; 50/50development suite is not independent validation.
BAS fidelity is not a new independent adjudication of football events; source alignment inherits original synchronization precision.
Pass distances are tracking-derived endpoint estimates; BAS support does not independently validate distance or reception.
No verified jersey or home-away identities, validated shot speeds/chance quality, saves, or football events for the3CV-only recordings.
Buildup is fixed context; recap priority is a declared heuristic.
12base+3extra controlled render fixtures do not establish99%general reliability.
Hosted Gemini verified for one query pattern; Microsoft highlight adapter has not been live-verified.
Jobs/session references live in memory; validated render caches survive restart but old job URLs do not.
Downloads disabled by default; enabling requires confirmed media rights.
